summary: Configured Nginx on RHEL 9 node1 to serve HTTP 200 at / on TCP port 6500. The configuration persisted across the required node restart and recovered successfully.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx from the RHEL repositories.
Configured Nginx to listen on IPv4 and IPv6 TCP port 6500.
Restarted node1 once and verified full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at / on TCP port 6500
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, nginx was active and enabled, listening on 0.0.0.0:6500 and [::]:6500, with direct requests to the managed node IP returning HTTP/1.1 200 and the configured page.

evidence.requirement: SELinux and firewall permit HTTP traffic on TCP 6500
evidence.summary: Confirmed TCP 6500 is labeled http_port_t and permanently permitted by firewalld before and after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 437b338f-0902-4c11-86df-0a6ea6308b8e; reboot acknowledgement was captured; node returned with changed boot ID a6e997d0-e375-46f4-9f31-2cf706f15e9a; post-restart checks proved valid configuration, active service, restored listeners, persisted page data, and HTTP 200 recovery.
